name: loomwiki
description: Cloudflare-native team workspace where chat is the input and a git-backed wiki is the output.

scripts.deploy:all: pnpm --filter @loomwiki/worker run deploy && pnpm --filter @loomwiki/web run deploy
scripts.migrate:local: pnpm --filter @loomwiki/worker exec wrangler d1 migrations apply loomwiki --local --config ../../wrangler.jsonc
scripts.migrate:remote: pnpm --filter @loomwiki/worker exec wrangler d1 migrations apply loomwiki --remote --config ../../wrangler.jsonc
scripts.migrate:new: pnpm --filter @loomwiki/worker exec wrangler d1 migrations create loomwiki --config ../../wrangler.jsonc
